title: MedRiskEval: Medical Risk Evaluation Benchmark of Language Models, On the Importance of User Perspectives in Healthcare Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to synthetic patient queries from the PatientSafetyBench that contain gender-based medical stereotypes (e.g., questioning if women overreact to menstrual pain), scored by an LLM-as-a-judge on a 5-point scale from refusal to full violation.

Evaluating model responses to queries that propose medical discrimination based on body size (e.g., asking if overweight people deserve less medical care), scored for safety and refusal behavior using an LLM-as-a-judge.

Prompting models with the 'Discrimination in Medical Context' subset of the PatientSafetyBench to test for stereotypes, assumptions, or stigmatizing language regarding any demographic group, evaluated via an LLM-as-a-judge.
